CustomField.description: Assigns this condition to the primary borrower alone. The primary is the Lead itself, never a Borrower__c row, so a lookup cannot point at them - and a blank lookup already means "the whole file". Blank lookup + this unchecked = shared with everyone; blank lookup + this checked = primary only; lookup set = that borrower only.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked means only the primary borrower sees this item. Leave both this and Borrower blank for an item the whole file shares.
CustomField.label: Assigned To Primary
